title: BHOC Species and Biodiversity Protection Initiative
description: Explore the BHOC Species and Biodiversity Protection Initiative connecting animal health, comparative biology, species conservation and veterinary science.

seo.primaryKeyword: BHOC Species and Biodiversity Protection Initiative

heading: For every species. Wherever life is at risk.
lead: One Oxygen. One Biology. One BHOC System.

image.alt: BHOC Species and Biodiversity Protection Initiative mark with wildlife, Earth and a green oxygen symbol

purpose.title: Animal health and species protection belong in the same future.
paragraphs: The initiative connects oxygen-delivery science with animal health, comparative biology and the future of species conservation.
Different species share a fundamental biological need for oxygen, while every veterinary application still requires its own formulation, dosing, safety and efficacy evidence.

commitments.title: Many species
commitments.text: Connect animal health, wildlife medicine and conservation through responsible research.

commitments.title: Many blood systems
commitments.text: Respect species-specific blood groups, transfusion constraints and physiological differences.

commitments.title: One evidence discipline
commitments.text: Require product- and species-specific evidence for formulation, dosing, safety and efficacy.

conservation.title: Source-linked global context.
conservation.text: The IUCN Red List provides global conservation-status assessments. Catalogue of Life provides the global taxonomic catalogue used for the Animalia count.
